knowledge_gaps: The timestamp pathway is unresolved: item-ID sequences do not uniquely identify users, interaction occurrences, or gaps. A deterministic sequence-to-gap lookup is therefore unsafe without demonstrated uniqueness. Specify an ID-only first experiment unless the existing inference contract provides unambiguous timestamps.

The additional retention gate overlaps with GRU reset/update gates. Its initialization, cumulative attenuation, interaction with the baseline recurrence, and parameter-matched controls are unspecified. Near-one retention can still substantially attenuate long histories.

The experimental plan lacks baseline validation HR@10, an explicit checkpoint/configuration selection rule, and a runtime allocation within 43,200 GPU-seconds. Repeated selection on 200 users per category risks validation overfitting.

Item-ID-conditioned retention does not directly encode semantic content or establish compatibility. Its connection to simulator complaints remains hypothetical. Originality 5 and difficulty 4 need qualification, particularly if timestamp plumbing and an unfused recurrent loop are required.

Mean cosine similarity near zero does not establish healthy embedding geometry: low-rank or antipodal representations can produce the same average. Diagnostic sampling, uncertainty, and embedding-spectrum checks are missing.
